gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with cranial MRI displaying typical features of high-grade glioma on imaging or histologically proven high-grade glioma including GBM, anaplastic astrocytoma (AA), anaplastic oligodendroglioma (AO).

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.
This trial is designed to evaluate safety and explore possible efficacy of 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (5-ALA HCl, Gliolan®) with CV01 delivery of ultrasound for sonodynamic therapy

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Patients With Newly Diagnosed High-Grade Glioma (HGG) Prior to Resection and Standard Adjuvant Therapy
No previous tumor specific treatment such as surgery (apart from biopsy), radio- or chemotherapy, antiangiogenic or immunotherapy.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Histopathological efficacy: Anti-tumor activity assessed by Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against IBA1 and Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against Caspase III

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Sonodynamic Therapy (SDT): Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.
Patients will receive 5-Aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride via oral administration (20 mg/kg) 6-8 hours before CV01 treatment.

agents.drug_class_hint: porphyrin precursor / photosensitiser prodrug (protoporphyrin IX), used here as sonosensitiser for sonodynamic therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonodynamic therapy (5-ALA combined with ultrasound sonication)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: IBA1 and cleaved caspase III immunohistochemistry in resected tumour (histopathological response to SDT)

source_quote.quote: Histopathological efficacy: Anti-tumor activity assessed by Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against IBA1 and Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against Caspase III

coder_notes: 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy with CV01 ultrasound device -> candidate, device_dependent true (device not listed as agent). SDT given before resection; standard radio-/chemotherapy follows resection but no drug is named and the experimental arm describes SDT only, so regimen coded monotherapy; an adjudicator may consider 'combination' because standard adjuvant radio-/chemotherapy follows. Temozolomide not named, so not listed. Target engagement coded yes on post-SDT tumour histopathology (IBA1, caspase III) in the resected specimen.
